other_conditions: Students in full‑time employment are not eligible for the scholarship.
Applicants must not be receiving any other scholarship or stipend for the same course of study.
Candidates who passed the qualifying examination more than one year before the award year are ineligible.
Good conduct and regular attendance are required for continuation of the scholarship.
The scholarship will be canceled if the scholar abandons or changes the chosen course of study without State Government approval.
The scholarship may be renewed year‑to‑year within the same stage of education.
Students may continue their studies within or outside Manipur but must remain within the country.
benefits_summary: Provides Rs. 6,000 per annum for two years to 300 Class X students and Rs. 12,000 per annum for three years to selected Class XII students (125 Science, 125 Social Sciences, 50 Commerce).
documents_required: Xerox copy of mark sheet of the qualifying examination
